tables.name: attendances
tables.createTable:
CREATE TABLE `attendances` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tenant_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `branch_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `staff_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `attendance_date` date NOT NULL,
  `shift_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `shift_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `scheduled_check_in` time DEFAULT NULL,
  `scheduled_check_out` time DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_overnight` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `actual_check_in` time DEFAULT NULL,
  `actual_check_out` time DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('PRESENT','ABSENT','HALF_DAY','WEEKLY_OFF','HOLIDAY','ON_LEAVE') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PRESENT',
  `late_minutes` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `early_departure_minutes` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `working_hours` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `remarks` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `correction_reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `corrected_by_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `corrected_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_attendance_tenant_staff_date` (`tenant_id`,`staff_id`,`attendance_date`),
  KEY `branch_id` (`branch_id`),
  KEY `staff_id` (`staff_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `shift_id` (`shift_id`),
  KEY `corrected_by_id` (`corrected_by_id`),
  KEY `idx_attendance_tenant_date` (`tenant_id`,`attendance_date`),
  KEY `idx_attendance_tenant_branch_date` (`tenant_id`,`branch_id`,`attendance_date`),
  KEY `idx_attendance_tenant_status` (`tenant_id`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `attendances_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `tenants` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `attendances_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`branch_id`) REFERENCES `branches` (`id`) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `attendances_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`staff_id`) REFERENCES `staff_profiles` (`id`) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `attendances_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `attendances_ibfk_5` FOREIGN KEY (`shift_id`) REFERENCES `shifts` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `attendances_ibfk_6` FOREIGN KEY (`corrected_by_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=27 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
